method: Independent read-only reconstruction from raw close, ex-date cash and split CSVs; no production signal/environment or diagnostics functions imported. Recomputed geometric-market next-five-session labels, past-20-session persistence volatility, prediction MSE and training-mean-reference MSE. Checked partition boundaries and row coverage. No new model training, policy evaluation, fitting or selection.
scope_limits: Uses archived fit target means and archived predictions as inputs; does not independently re-estimate Ridge coefficients or prove absence of every possible leakage channel.
Feature causality and training causality are checked by separate automated tests.
This verifies arithmetic and alignment, not predictive significance or future returns.
